chapter.verse: Itna na delh tham loin Pasian’ Thu hilh nadingin Kha Siangtho hong piak thuphate na deih pha un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, kamtuam tawh a gen mi in mite kiangah a gen ahi kei hi, Pasian kiangah a gen hi; kuamah in ama kam a thei kei hi, Kha Siangtho tawh thuthuk a gen hi.
Ahi zongin kamsang mi in kipsakna thu, hansuahna thu, nopsakna thute mite kiangah a hilh hi.
Kamtuam tawh a gen mi in ama pumpi bek a kipsak hi. Kamsang mi in pawlpi a kipsak hi.

Note khempeuh in kamtuam tawh gen thei le-uh teh ka deih hi. Ahih hangin kamsang le-uh teh ka deihzaw hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, pau namtuam tawh a gen mi in pawlpi kipsak nadingin a khiatna a gen kei leh, amah sangin kamsang mi a lianzaw hi.

Ute naute aw, note kiangah kong tun’ ciangin pau namtuam tawh kong gen hangin hong piak kholhna gen kikna ahi zongin, lungpilna lahna ahi zongin, kamsan’na ahi zongin, thupiakna ahi zongin tuate khat beek hih loin note kiangah kong hilh leh, bang phattuamna a om ding hiam?
Tua mah bangin a aw a ging thei, hin’na a nei lo gawsem ahi zongin, tamngai ahi zongin, a aw a kilamdangin a gin’ kei leh, gawsem aw ahi zongin, tamngai aw ahi zongin bangci kitheih ding ahi hiam?
Peengkul in zong a man lopi-in a gin’ leh, galkap ding kua in a kisa ding hiam?
Tua mah bangin note in a theih baih ding kam na gen kei uh leh, na thu gen uh bangci kitheih ding ahi hiam? Huih laka gen tawh na kibang ding uh hi.
Leitungah kam pawl tampi om a, khiatna a nei ciat hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kam khiatna ka theih kei leh, a hong hilhpa ading kei in mipil lo bang ka hi ding hi; a hong hilhpa in zong kei ading mipil lo ahi ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in zong Kha Siangtho hong piak thuphate na deih mahmah uh ahih ciangin pawlpi kipsak nading, na kicin’ nadingun na hahkat un.
Tua ahih ciangin pau namtuam a gen mi in a khiatna zong a gen theih nadingin thu ngen hen.
Pau namtuam tawh thu ka nget leh, ka lungsim in thu a nget hangin ka pilna in phattuamna a ngah kei hi.
Tua ahih leh, bang kici ding hiam? Kha tawh thu ka ngen ding hi, pilna tawh zong thu ka ngen ding hi. Kha tawh la ka sa ding hi, pilna tawh zong la ka sa ding hi.
Ahih kei leh, kha tawh hehpihna na phat ciangin a siam lo mi in na kam thei lo ahih ciangin hehpihna phatna-ah zui-in, “Amen” bang ci-a ci thei ding hiam?
Nang in hehpihna pha takpi-in na phat hangin midang ading kipna a piang kei hi.
Note khempeuh sangin keimah in pautuam dang gen thei ka hih ciangin Pasian’ hehpihna ka phat hi.
Ahih hangin pawlpi lakah pautuam dang tawh kam thenkhat ka gen theih sangin midangte hilh thei nadingin kam nga bek lungpilna tawh hilh theih nading ka deihzaw hi.
Ute naute aw, pilna lamah naupang bang kei un. Gitlohna lamah nawine naungeek bang un. Lungpilna lamah a khan’ khinte bang un.
Thukham lai sungah: “Pautuam a neite leh mipawl dangte’ kam tawh hih mipawlte ka hilh ding hi. Ahih hangin ka thu a ngai kei ding uh hi, ci-in Topa in thu a pia hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin pautuam dangte in thu-umte ading lim ahi kei hi, a um lote ading lim ahi hi. Kamsan’na ahih leh, a um lote ading lim ahi kei hi; a umte ading lim ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin pawlpi khempeuh kikhawmin, pautuam dang tawh na kihilh lai takun a um lote ahi zongin, a siam lote ahi zongin hong tum leh, “Note mihai na hi uh,” hong ci ding uh hilo ahi hiam?
Mi khempeuhte in kamsangin a om lai takin a um lo mi ahi zongin, a siam lo mi ahi zongin hong tum ciangin pawlpi khempeuh in tua pa mawhsakin, nakpi takin amah kingaihsun sak ding uh hi.
Tua pa in a lungsim sunga a selsim khempeuh kilang khia-in, amah in, “Pasian in note lakah a om takpi hi,” ci-in genin, bokin Pasian a bia ding hi.

Ute naute aw, koici bang ahi hiam? Na kikhop uh ciangin lasakna ahi zongin, thuhilhna ahi zongin, Pasian’ lahkhiat thugenna ahi zongin, pau namtuam pauna ahi zongin, a khiatna gen theihna ahi zongin na nei ciat uh ahih ciangin pawlpi kipsak nadingin na khempeuh na hih un.
Pau namtuam dang tawh kamsan’na a om leh, nih ahi zongin, a tam belin thum ahi zongin, khat khit ciangin khat in gen uh hen la, khat in a khiatna genkik ta hen.
Kamphen a om kei leh, tua mipa in pawlpi lakah gen loin om hen; amahmah ahi zongin, Pasian kiang ahi zongin gen hen.
Kamsangte in nih ahi zongin, thum ahi zongin kamsang uh hen la, midangte in sittel uh hen.
A tu mite’ kiangah na khatpeuh peuh a kilah leh, a gen masapa pau loin om ta hen.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a om mi khempeuh in theitel-a tha a ngah theih nading ahi zongin, note khat nungah khat in kamsan’na na nei thei uh hi.
Kamsangte’ kha in kamsangte’ ukna nuai-ah a om ding uh hi.
Pasian in kitotna tawh kipawl Pasian hi loin kilemna tawh kipawl Pasian ahi hi.

Misiangthote’ pawlpi khempeuh sung panin numeite in pawlpi lakah pau loin om ta uh hen. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amau in thuhilh nading thu a om kei hi. Thukham in a tan’sa bangin amau in ukna nuai-ah om ta uh hen.
Numeite in thu khatpeuh peuh a sin nop uh leh, innah a pasalte kiangah dong ta uh hen. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, pawlpi lakah thu a gen ding uh a zumhuai hi.
Pasian’ thu in note pana hong piang ahi hiam? Ahih kei leh, note tung beka hong tung ahi hiam?

Mi khat peuhpeuh in kamsang mi ka hi hi ci-in ahi zongin, Kha Siangtho piaksa thupha a ngah mi ka hi hi ci-in ahi zongin, a ki-up leh note’ kiangah kong piak thute in Topa’ thupiakna ahi hi, ci-in mang ta hen.
A kitheih mawhbawl mi, a thusim lo mi a om leh amahmah thu thei loin a omcip ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka ute ka naute aw, note in kamsan’ ding na ut takpi ta un. Kamtuam tawh pau ding na khaam kei un.
Na khempeuh akilawm akituakin na hih un.
